key_provisions_or_claims: Premise that AI incidents are inevitable; strengthen detective as well as preventive controls.
Introduces observability and controllability as evaluation criteria for AI incident response.
Extends NIST SP 800-61 style incident response to RAG and AI agents.
Relies on SBOM for AI (G7 shared vision) and NIST Cyber AI Profile for supply-chain transparency and traceability.
Addresses contractual actions by AI agents (UNCITRAL Model Law on Automated Contracting) and strategic investment in response.
named_instruments_referenced: UNCITRAL Model Law on Automated Contracting
G7 Shared Vision on SBOM for AI
annotation.summary_en: Japan AI Safety Institute's conceptual approach book proposing the AI Incident Response System (AI-IRS), extending conventional incident response (NIST SP 800-61) to AI via observability and controllability, with analysis of RAG and AI agents, SBOM for AI, and supply-chain transparency. Voluntary guidance for organizations.
annotation.title_clean: Approach Book for AI Incident Response: A Foundation for Trustworthy AI (AI-IRS)
annotation.title_en: Approach Book for AI Incident Response: A Foundation for Trustworthy AI (AI-IRS)
